# QuillBot

> > QuillBot is a comprehensive AI-powered writing suite offering paraphrasing, grammar checking, plagiarism detection, AI humanization, and content generation tools.

QuillBot provides free and premium writing assistance tools powered by artificial intelligence, including paraphrasing, grammar checking, plagiarism detection, AI content detection, and humanization. The platform offers browser extensions, desktop applications, team plans, and integrations with popular applications like Microsoft Word and Slack.

## Key Topics

- AI Writing Assistant
- Paraphrasing Tool
- Grammar Checker
- Plagiarism Detector
- AI Humanizer
- AI Content Detection
- Citation Generator
- Text Summarizer
- AI Chat
- AI Image Generator
- Translation Tool
- Chrome Extension
- Microsoft Word Integration
- Free Tools
- Premium Subscription

## Core Writing Tools

- [Paraphrasing Tool](https://quillbot.com/paraphrasing-tool): Free AI-powered paraphraser for text rewriting and tone adjustment
- [Grammar Checker](https://quillbot.com/grammar-check): Free AI grammar, spelling, and punctuation checker tool
- [Plagiarism Checker](https://quillbot.com/plagiarism-checker): Advanced plagiarism detection and content analysis tool
- [Sentence Rewriter](https://quillbot.com/sentence-rewriter): Free AI sentence rewriter for polished text transformation
- [Citation Generator](https://quillbot.com/citation-generator): Free citation generator for APA, MLA, Chicago, and Harvard styles

## AI Content Tools

- [AI Detector](https://quillbot.com/ai-content-detector): AI content detector for ChatGPT, GPT-5, Gemini, and Claude
- [AI Humanizer](https://quillbot.com/ai-humanizer): AI humanizer to transform ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini text naturally
- [AI Chat](https://quillbot.com/ai-chat): Free AI chat for brainstorming, drafting, and research assistance
- [AI Image Generator](https://quillbot.com/ai-image-generator): Free text-to-image AI generator for royalty-free artwork
- [Text Summarizer](https://quillbot.com/summarize): Free AI text summarizer for articles, papers, and documents

## Language & Translation

- [QuillBot Translate](https://quillbot.com/translate): AI translation tool supporting 50+ languages with cultural tips

## Desktop & Browser Integration

- [QuillBot for Microsoft Word](https://quillbot.com/word): QuillBot add-in for Microsoft Word desktop and online
- [QuillBot for macOS](https://quillbot.com/app/mac): QuillBot macOS desktop app for Word, Mail, Slack integration
